1.20.1.1.3.1: First release of the Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) edition: milestone tracking, quantity and tag targets, presets, world-first records, export/import, the item picker GUI and the public API.
1.20.1.1.4.0: Feature release for the Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) edition: saved-data schema versioning, tolerant record loading and evacuation of unreadable records, extended preset definitions and auto-add flows, preset show/diff and share/importcode commands, tag-target renametag and strict preset validation, plus review and pre-release fixes.
1.20.1.1.7.0: Feature release for the Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) edition: adds the step-5 operations group — seven opt-in permission nodes for fine-grained access, read-only `/iml doctor` and `/iml admin debug` diagnostics, Discord payload previews, `discordstatus` and a manual digest, `backup now`/`list`/`verify` commands, and a structured administrator audit log with documented `audit.1.log`–`audit.5.log` rotation. Existing permissions, defaults, saved data and command behaviour are unchanged unless the new nodes are granted; known limitation: `itemmilestonelog.debug` still requires the `admin` parent gate, with restructuring pending a spec decision.
